what_is_it.explanation: Utopia is an enterprise world model built with a bitemporal knowledge graph and ontology base layer. It automatically ingests documents and data, resolves entity duplicates, detects conflicts, and enables semantic search, chat, and agentic RAG over your data. It operates as a self-hosted application packaged in a single Rust binary and Postgres instance.
